content.what_it_is: Sample/initial-condition routines for a left-boundary solitary wave; dormant hand-coded initial tests; rectangular, Gaussian, dipole, N-wave and solitary-wave fields; and a Newton solution for solitary-wave coefficients (L47-L634). Cartesian and angular-grid interfaces are selected by preprocessing, with parallel/MGPU coordinate offsets.
entities: SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY with aa/h00/c1/tex/tlag/zz and Iwavemaker around L55-L82
INITIAL_WAVE with XX/YY, sigma/x_c/y_c/a/r, ii1/ii2 and label-controlled sample blocks around L92-L155
INITIAL_RECTANGULAR with Cartesian or angular-grid dummies and Il/Jl/Ir/Jr around L167-L248
INITIAL_GAUSIAN with grid/center/amplitude/width inputs and r/xr/yr around L260-L341
INITIAL_N_WAVE with a0/gamma and U/V/Eta outputs around L438-L501
INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE with A/B/A1/A2/alpha/SC/Cph/C_ph and direction flag around L513-L570
SUB_SLTRY with polynomial/Newton scratch alp2/p/q/r/x/fx/fpx/rx/cph/eps/zr/g and ite around L582-L634
calls: SUB_SLTRY uses STOP for invalid/nonconvergent cases around L610
unresolved: INITIAL_WAVE is effectively a no-op for Eta: unconditional `goto 200` skips the box assignment, unconditional `goto 100` skips the dam-break assignment, the Gaussian assignment is commented, and `goto 213` skips the alongshore crest. XX/YY and scalar parameters are computed but no active initial field is written.

INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE accepts Beta and even shows the intended alpha formula in a comment, but unconditionally assigns alpha=-0.39 before calling SUB_SLTRY. Thus Beta does not affect the generated solution and all caller-selected beta values collapse to one profile.

INITIAL_N_WAVE accepts gamma_s and x2 but never uses either in active code; the x2-dependent general N-wave expression is commented and gamma is recomputed locally. The public interface therefore advertises controls that do not affect output.

The parallel INITIAL_RECTANGULAR branch clips Il/Ir/Jl/Jr to array limits and handles no-overlap, while the serial branch writes Eta(Il:Ir,Jl:Jr) without any clipping. Rectangles partly or wholly outside the serial grid can create invalid sections or runtime bounds errors.

Gaussian and dipole formulas divide by WID and WID**2 without a positive-width check. SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY and SUB_SLTRY similarly divide by h00/h1 and amplitude ratios without validating their domains.

SUB_SLTRY performs x=x-fx/fpx before checking iteration count and never guards fpx=0. Subsequent SQRT expressions require x and (alp2-alp*x) domains that are also unchecked, so the advertised STOP path does not protect singular Newton steps or invalid roots.

For non-Cartesian variable spacing, INITIAL_WAVE, INITIAL_N_WAVE and INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE estimate position by multiplying a local DX(I,J) by an index rather than accumulating cell widths. Correctness therefore depends on DX being uniform despite its array-valued interface.
The file banner says sample.F while the actual path is samples.F; this is a provenance-name mismatch.
